1. verus! {
2. 
3. // `PAGE_ALIGNMENT` is an external (arch-crate) constant. Model it so that verified
4. // exec code referencing it has a Verus specification. The page alignment's numeric
5. // value is the page size (both are 4096 on the supported target), which is the link
6. // that lets `from_address` relate `is_aligned(PAGE_ALIGNMENT)` to `spec_page_size()`.
7. pub assume_specification[ ::arch::mem::PAGE_ALIGNMENT ] -> (result: Alignment)
8.     ensures
9.         ::sys::mm::spec_align_value(result) == spec_page_size(),
10. ;
11. 
12. // Success condition for the validating constructor, stated purely on the abstract
13. // address value. `from_address` validates, it does NOT normalize: success requires the
14. // *input* to already be page-aligned.
15. pub open spec fn spec_aligned(addr_view: int) -> bool {
16.     addr_view % spec_page_size() == 0
17. }
18. 
19. // Dependency contract for the `PageAligned` `Deref` method.
20. //
21. // The `impl<T: Address> Address for PageAligned<T>` block is now `#[verus_verify]`, so its
22. // `into_raw_value` is verified in-body against the `Address` trait's `#[verus_spec]` contract
23. // and no longer needs a trusted specification here.
24. //
25. // `Deref`, however, is a `core` (std) trait with no Verus contract to inherit, so the
26. // `impl<T: Address> Deref for PageAligned<T>` block stays a plain impl and its `deref` is
27. // treated as *external*. The HAL frame layer and `mm::phys` call it from verified code, so it
28. // needs a trusted specification. This was previously declared in `mm/phys/frame.spec.rs`; it
29. // belongs here next to the type it describes. Removing it (the contract equals `result == a@`)
30. // breaks the verus build with "cannot use function ... which is ignored because it is ...
31. // external".
32. pub assume_specification<T: Address>[ <crate::hal::mem::PageAligned<T> as ::core::ops::Deref>::deref ](
33.     a: &crate::hal::mem::PageAligned<T>,
34. ) -> (result: &<crate::hal::mem::PageAligned<T> as ::core::ops::Deref>::Target)
35.     ensures
36.         (*result)@ == a@,
37. ;
38. 
39. } // verus!
40.
